FreeQrly vs QR Tiger: Free Dynamic Codes, Scan Limits, and Price | FreeQrly

FreeQrly vs QR Tiger on the free plan: 20 dynamic codes (currently unlimited) with unlimited scans, versus 3 codes capped at 500 scans each. Static codes are free on both. Pro costs $9/month; QR Tiger Regular starts at $7/month.
FreeQrly vs QR Tiger: where the free plan ends.

If you only need static codes, both tools are free forever. The difference starts with dynamic codes: FreeQrly — freeqrly.com gives you 20 free dynamic codes (currently unlimited during the limited-time offer) with unlimited scans, while QR Tiger's free plan gives you 3 dynamic codes capped at 500 scans each. Pick by how many editable codes you print, and how many scans they will get.
1Decide static or dynamicStatic fits anything that never changes: a homepage, a WiFi login, a business card. Dynamic fits anything you may repoint or measure: a sale page, a menu, a campaign poster.

Pick FreeQrly if you print more than 3 editable codes, or any code that might pass 500 scans; if you want batch creation, a barcode generator, or a QR API without paying; or if you want free static codes with no account at all. If you ever cancel Pro, your codes keep working.

Pick QR Tiger if you need its campaign extras — saved design templates, retargeting, password protection, expiry controls, geofencing, and white-label domains on Premium — or its enterprise seats and integrations (Canva, Monday.com, Zapier, HubSpot on higher tiers). For raw editable-code count, FreeQrly Pro is unlimited, so Tiger's edge is features and team tooling, not volume.
Do I need an account for static codes on either tool?
No. FreeQrly static codes need no sign-up, and QR Tiger's free plan includes unlimited static codes. The account question only matters for dynamic codes, and both need a free account there.
What happens when a QR Tiger free dynamic code reaches 500 scans?
QR Tiger lists a 500 scan limit on each free dynamic code. FreeQrly gives unlimited scans on free dynamic codes, so a poster that takes off does not hit a ceiling at 500.

QR Tiger's Regular plan starts at $7 per month, below FreeQrly Pro at $9 per month (or $90 per year). The trade is allowance: Regular includes 12 dynamic codes, while FreeQrly Pro is unlimited. If you need more than 12 editable codes, the cheaper sticker price stops being cheaper per code.
Can I edit a printed code on both free plans?

Yes. QR Tiger's free dynamic codes can be edited and tracked, and FreeQrly's free dynamic codes can be edited after printing with scan statistics. The difference is quantity and the scan limit, not the ability itself.
